content.short: ETHRank is an open source achievement system for every Ethereum address.
content.description: ETHRank is an open-source achievement system and API built for every Ethereum address. It maintains a growing catalog of goals and milestones, updating every six months with fresh objectives and achievements. In tandem with new content, the project refreshes its design and branding, ensuring a current and cohesive experience across supported chains. ETHRank aims to formalize on-chain activity into recognizable milestones while remaining accessible and transparent for developers and users alike.

resources.title: Scoring an Address by What It Has Done
resources.tldr: Points across DeFi, NFTs, staking and reputation, issued as badges that update daily. Open source, so the scoring is auditable.
